requirement.title: Cut-out reveals stopped vehicle
requirement.text: If the lead vehicle changes out of the ego lane and thereby reveals a stopped vehicle ahead in the ego lane, the ego vehicle shall not collide and shall stop with a gap of at least 2 m.

scenario.rationale: A moving lead vehicle leaves the ego lane to reveal a stopped vehicle, testing whether ACC emergency braking prevents collision and stops the ego with at least a 2 m gap.

gt.activation_note: stopped vehicle hidden behind the lead; ego reaches standstill
gt.label: correct & effective
